verification: GitHub Git-data commit metadata reports the recorded published tree and parent.
The fetched detached worktree HEAD and local-reviewed commit resolve to the identical full Git tree ID.
Tree identity covers all tracked paths, file bytes and Git modes; commit metadata/ancestry is intentionally different.

unchangedAuditPins.availability: All are existing ancestors of the published parent and available to a full-history clone. No unpublished brand/governance implementation SHA is required by active validators.

historicalEvidence: Previous local execution records and outcomes remain unchanged. This record establishes tree equivalence; it does not turn any earlier local execution into an execution of the published commit.
execution: The commands in commands.json were newly executed locally against the fetched published commit; they are not GitHub Actions or provider runs.
approvalBoundary: Scoped independent code review only; no brand/visual/consumer/publication acceptance.
